description: This Python script is designed to parse a JSON file representing a Figma screen. It detects all image, icon, and vector components, then extracts or downloads the assets (images or SVG placeholders) into a specified assets directory. The script also supports fetching real SVGs via Figma API if credentials are provided, and generates a manifest JSON with details of all processed assets.

methods.name: None ensure_dir(p: Path)
methods.description: Ensures that the specified directory exists by creating it if necessary.

methods.name: str slugify(text: str)
methods.description: Converts a text string into a safe filename slug by lowercasing and replacing non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens.

methods.name: bytes fetch_binary(url: str, timeout: int = 30)
methods.description: Fetches binary content from a given URL, with a timeout.

methods.name: None write_binary(path: Path, data: bytes)
methods.description: Writes binary data to the specified file path.

methods.name: None write_text(path: Path, data: str)
methods.description: Writes string data to the specified file path with UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] load_json(path: Path)
methods.description: Loads and parses JSON data from a given file path.

methods.name: None save_json(path: Path, obj: Any)
methods.description: Saves a Python object as JSON to a specified file path.

methods.name: bool is_vector_node(node: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Determines if a node represents a vector/icon based on 'figma_type' or 'type' fields.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[float],Optional[float]] node_dimensions(node: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Returns the width and height of a node if available.

methods.name: str node_identifier(node: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Generates a filename-friendly identifier for a node based on its name and id.

methods.name: str figma_images_api_url(file_key: str, ids: List[str], fmt: str = "svg")
methods.description: Constructs the URL for Figma's images API endpoint with file key, node ids, and format.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] figma_fetch_images(file_key: str, ids: List[str], token: str, fmt: str = "svg")
methods.description: Calls Figma's API to get image URLs for specified node ids, using the provided token.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] traverse_nodes(root: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Performs a depth-first traversal to flatten all nodes in the JSON tree.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] extract_assets( screen_json_path: Path, assets_dir: Path, figma_token: Optional[str] = None, file_key: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Main function that extracts assets from a Figma JSON file into a specified directory, optionally fetching real SVGs via Figma API, and returns a manifest with details.
